body.text:
As seamark.dev is down at the moment, and atcr.io doesn't allow public/anonymous access to its images there's no way to anonymously get the images from my self-hosted hold. This seemed like a solvable issue for a decentralised container system!

This is a proposal for allowing the hold to act _directly_ as a (read-only!) OCI v2 API  (if the  setting is specifically enabled or ). The hold still requires the image owner's PDS to be up (to get the manifests).

This is only available when:
- the `server.registry_pull` setting is on, or `HOLD_SERVER_REGISTRY_PULL=true`
- The hold is `public: true`
- The requested image is owned by the captain or crew member

Blobs are redirected to presigned URLs, direct from the bucket.

---

Please let me know what you think @evan.jarrett.net—this may not be a direction you're interested in, I shan't be offended if that's the case 😊

title.text: Allow holds to act as an OCI v2 (read only) API
